painterly.label: Pictórico
painterly.base_prompt: Hand-painted romantic 19th-century oil painting on canvas with the fine linework of a steel engraving, as in an illustrated 1850s edition of Goethe's Faust (in the spirit of Delacroix's Faust lithographs and Caspar David Friedrich). Clearly painted, NOT photorealistic, NOT a 3D render, NOT digital concept art: visible loose brushstrokes, subtle engraved cross-hatching in the shadows, slightly aged varnish. Muted earthy palette of umber, ochre, slate blue and ivory with restrained deep crimson accents. Soft chiaroscuro, single warm key light from the upper left. Semi-realistic proportions. No text, no letters, no signature, no watermark, no frame, no border.

templates.background: Visual novel background, 16:9 wide establishing shot at eye level, empty foreground band in the bottom third, no people unless described.
templates.sprite: Visual novel character sprite, 2:3 portrait. One character, standing, framed from the top of the head to mid-thigh, centred, body turned slightly toward the viewer, whole head and both hands inside the frame with clear margin above the head. Legs below mid-thigh and feet are not visible. The background is a perfectly flat, uniform chroma-green (#00B140) field with no gradient, no floor, no shadow and no props. No green anywhere on the character.
templates.variant: Use the reference image: keep exactly the same character, face, hair, costume, framing, scale, lighting and flat chroma-green (#00B140) background. Change only the facial expression and pose of the hands as described.

anime.label: Anime
anime.base_prompt: High-quality modern Japanese visual novel art (anime style) for a gothic-romantic adaptation of Goethe's Faust. Clean, confident lineart; cel shading with soft gradient highlights and subtle rim light; expressive eyes but mature adult anatomy and proportions (not chibi, not childlike, not moe). Elegant historically grounded 16th-century German costume and architecture. Harmonious palette of deep indigo, umber, crimson and parchment ivory with gold accents. Polished commercial visual-novel finish. No text, no letters, no signature, no watermark, no frame, no border.
